maddeler.e:
أستحصل (form X)
# أَسْتَحْصِلُ (ʔastaḥṣilu) /ʔas.taħ.sˤi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْصَلَ (istaḥṣala)
# أُسْتَحْصَلُ (ʔustaḥṣalu) /ʔus.taħ.sˤa.lu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحْصَلَ (istaḥṣala)
# أَسْتَحْصِلَ (ʔastaḥṣila) /ʔas.taħ.sˤi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَحْصَلَ (istaḥṣala)
# أُسْتَحْصَل
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
